'''Cicara Tuk''' was an [[Aramandi]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. Tuk was hired by a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] to transport a large amount of Aramandi artwork and trinkets for further sale to wealthy collectors. Instead of delivering the shipment, Tuk took the money that he was paid to acquire the items and disappeared.

{{RPGseed}}
The crime lord subsequently hired a group of independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to track him down. Tuk hid on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genesia]] until the spacers found him, forcing him to flee to the [[Aramand system/Legends|Aramand system]]. Despite being a member of the [[Seelas]], Tuk [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forged]] credentials showing he was a member of the [[Mila (akia)|Mila]] [[akia]] and was taken under the protection of the [[Taler]]. The spacers were able to prove Tuk's credentials were faked to the leadership of the Mila.

==Behind the scenes==
Cicara Tuk was introduced in an RPG adventure seed in ''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''. The individual that Cicara Tuk owes money to is dependent on whichever crimelord the player characters have a better relationship with, either [[Qual'om Soach]] or [[Eelien Kirat]].
